associations._note: RE-ADDED AT P8 FIX a3 2026-08-08 - AND THIS IS THE SECOND TIME. The +5V rail carries C108 (22 uF bulk) and C109 (100 nF HF) - both wired to +5V in the netlist (net 1: C108.1 C109.1 C110.2 FB201.1 L101.2 R101.1) - but this sidecar is REWRITTEN FROM SCRATCH by kicad/gen/root.py (Project.save(..., decoupling=...)), and schlib's place_ic_with_decoupling only emits IC-PIN bypass entries. So every root-schematic regeneration deletes these two hand entries and check_pdn goes straight back to 'power rail +5V (0.3 A) has no decoupling capacitors' - a metadata gap, not a board defect. It happened at the 22:12 regen on 2026-08-08 and cost one verify error. CHECK THIS FILE AFTER ANY root.py RUN. The served pin is L101.2, the buck's output node: +5V has no IC LOAD pin on it (the load, U201, sits behind FB201 on +5V_DRV), so the point these caps have to hold up IS the inductor output. C110 is deliberately NOT listed - it is Cr in the LM5017 Type-3 ripple-injection network, not a decoupler.
